PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT ABLE TO WORK WITH CANDIDATES ON H1B VISAS OR CANDIDATES REPRESENTED BY THIRD PARTIES. 
 

 This position requires an individual with exceptional analytical and technical skills developing and supporting .Net & C# applications. The preferred individual for this role should have outstanding communications skills (verbal and written), meeting facilitation skills, highly accomplished personal organizational skills and big picture view to drive business solutions. 

 Previous Application development/Support experience (5 years minimum)
 C# development experience (5 years minimum)
 .Net development experience (3 years minimum)
 Previous consulting experience (3 years minimum)
 Web Services development (3 years minimum) {SOAP & Restful}
 Ability to work independently Good verbal and written communications skills
